_note: MLIPs benchmarked. family = environment (dependency conflicts: MACE conflicts with SevenNet/MatterSim/fairchem; GRACE needs TensorFlow). kwargs go to the MaterialsFramework calculator class. training = main training data (overlap with MP/Alexandria/OMat24 matters for MLIP-vs-DFT).

grace-2l-omat.licence: tensorpotential code and GRACE-2L-OMAT weights: Academic Software License (ASL, non-commercial; publishing results allowed)

mace-mpa-0.licence: MIT (mace-torch code; MACE-MPA-0 weights MIT per mace foundations_models)

mace-omat-0.licence: MIT code; MACE-OMAT-0 weights Academic Software License (ASL, non-commercial; publishing results allowed)

sevennet-omni.training: multi-fidelity: MPtrj, sAlex, OMat24, ... (modal mpa = MP-compatible head)

mattersim-5m.training: MatterSim proprietary sampling (PBE/PBE+U, MP-compatible settings), ~17M structures

chgnet-0.3.0.licence: Modified BSD-3-Clause (LBNL / UC Berkeley), code and bundled weights
chgnet-0.3.0._note: check_cuda_mem false: CHGNet's default queries nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo to pick a GPU, which is NotSupported on GB10 unified memory (DGX Spark); it only affects device selection, not energies.

uma-m-1p1.training: OMat24 + OMol25 + OC20 + ODAC + OMC (task omat)
uma-m-1p1.licence: FAIR Chemistry License v1 (weights gated on Hugging Face facebook/UMA; research use and publishing results permitted under its acceptable-use policy; needs HF token with accepted licence)

_note_correction: predicts_mp2020_corrected: the model's training targets already include the Materials Project 2020 compatibility corrections (CHGNet: MPtrj corrected energies); then no correction is added. Verified empirically in the pilot (MLIP - MP on compounds with a non-zero MP correction).
